subject: general
question: Which of the following is the highest award in the Rashtriya Vigyan Puraskar awards?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Vigyan Ratna**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Vigyan Ratna: This award is the highest individual honor for lifetime contributions to science.
 
• Vigyan Shri: This category honors scientists for notable achievements in specific fields of science.
 
• Vigyan Yuva Shanti Swarup Bhatnagar: Recognizes young scientists who have made significant contributions in their early careers.
 
• Vigyan Team Award: Given to teams for their collective achievements and contributions to scientific progress.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Prof. Govindarajan Padmanabhan was honored with the Rashtriya Vigyan Puraskar 2024 in the category of Vigyan Ratna.
 
• The Vigyan Ratna is one of the highest honors in the scientific community in India.
 
• Prof. Govindarajan Padmanabhan is recognized for his outstanding contributions to science.
 
• The awards were presented by the President of India to acknowledge significant achievements in various scientific disciplines.
